metadata.title: पिंजड़े में  मछली की खेती | Adivasi Dignity: Cage Fishing in Jharkhand
metadata.description:
This episode takes you to the vast waters of the Getalsud Dam in Jharkhand, where a powerful story of dignity, resilience, and sustainable livelihoods is unfolding. Families who once depended on rivers, streams, and ponds for subsistence fishing are now embracing modern cage fishing—raising fish inside controlled cages installed in the dam.

Cage fishing has emerged as a game-changer for families displaced by the dam, offering them a stable source of income and renewed hope. With improved earnings, their quality of life has significantly improved, turning uncertainty into opportunity. As the fishers themselves say, cage fishing has become like an “ATM,” providing regular and reliable income.

Supported by the Jharkhand government through subsidies on fish feed, seed, cages, nets, and motorboats, cage fishing is transforming the fisheries sector in the state. From families that once relied on risky and illegal fishing methods to earning lakhs of rupees annually, the dam has transformed from a symbol of displacement into a source of prosperity.

Through initiatives like cage fishing, Jharkhand is steadily emerging as a leading state in the fisheries sector. The state is not only moving towards self-reliance in fish production but is also on the path to becoming a supplier of fish to other states in the near future.
